scope: Source-only peer review of the four requested diagnostic driver/test files; no UI, browser, resource guard, product source, workflow, or repository writes.
findings: The screenshot path still requires the exact public demo URL, exactly one selected pane tab with an active controlled pane, and a fixed known control; it refuses missing/duplicate targets, nonempty sensitive controls, empty/out-of-viewport crops, and unexpected hit targets before capture.

Out-of-viewport diagnostics contain only finite numeric rect/viewport/visible dimensions projected with an absolute 1,000,000 bound. A targeted test observes the zero-visible-height case and verifies Page.captureScreenshot is never called. Existing wrong-label test verifies the private-label target is refused.

The new pre-Done collector walks the exact closed shadow root of #matrx-data-picker-host, selects #picked, then counts .picked-item rows. This matches src/lib/data-pattern/picker.ts, which renders that container and one .picked-item div per selected field. Zero or any count other than one fails before Done and is projected as a bounded count; finally cleanup attempts picker Cancel and then DataView Cancel when ready.

After Done, the runner still requires exactly one DataView selected field, cancel readiness, and the guest explanation before checking the public selector and canceling the draft. It does not add a save/auth action. The failure-boundary test exercises count=0 and asserts Done was not clicked; it also exercises Done hit-target failure and cleanup.
limitations: No dedicated stale-tab/active-pane mismatch fault-injection case was added in these four files. This is remaining integration coverage, not an identified source correctness issue; code refuses when the selected tab has no controlled active pane.

The closed-shadow count integration is source-matched but its tests stub pickerSelectedCount; exact candidate behavior still needs the authorized hosted rerun. This review is not product-fix proof, native UI proof, or candidate acceptance.
cleanup: No browser/profile state changed; no source edits or commits made.
verdictMeaning: Source review is acceptable for this diagnostic-only patch, with hosted candidate rerun still required. The stale selected-tab/active-pane case is an integration coverage gap, not an observed correctness defect: the implementation independently requires exactly one selected tab, resolves its aria-controls pane, and requires data-state=active before screenshot targeting.
